summary: Bitterroot NF cabin in Idaho County, ID (c.1939); destroyed 1955 per two listings, while a 50-foot tower was torn down in 1956. No source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Destroyed in 1955 per two listings; the Forest Lookouts listing has a 50-foot tower torn down in 1956. No source describes the site today.

visit.trail_note: Listed as a hike-in site by Idaho Fire Lookouts

events.note: Listed as destroyed; Forest Lookouts listing has the tower torn down in 1956
50-foot tower torn down, usable parts salvaged (Forest Lookouts listing)

evidence.supports: about 10 miles north-northeast of Magruder Ranger Station
50-foot tower torn down 1956, usable parts salvaged
evidence.quote: 1956: The 50-foot tower torn down and usable parts salvaged.

corrections.why: The Forest Lookouts listing describes a 50-foot tower torn down in 1956, and the record's height (15.2 m) matches a tower, not a ground cabin. Firelookout.com titles the site a cabin, so a human should check whether the cabin stood on that tower.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts say destroyed in 1955; the Forest Lookouts listing has a 50-foot tower torn down in 1956. The story gives both.

sources.title: Burnt Strip Mtn. Fire Lookout Cabin

notes_for_editor: Destroyed year is 1955 in two listings and 1956 (tower torn down) in the Forest Lookouts listing; both are in the story. The Forest Lookouts listing cites Kresek only for the c.1939 cabin date, so its 1956 entry is not attributed to Kresek. The 50-foot figure and height_m 15.2 come only from the Forest Lookouts listing, which does not say whether that is total height or height to the cab floor. The record's 'ground' kind may be wrong (see corrections). The photo on the Forest Lookouts listing carries 'Permission for use required' (Kenneth E. Carpenter collection), so no photo was added. No source describes the site today, and no access level is set because none states one. No staffing or fire history appears in any source read.
